scenes.basis: 5:2 "brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet" - no place is named; it follows the Jerusalem community scenes of 4:23-37
5:12 "They were all with one accord in Solomon's porch"
5:18 "laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody" - the arrest and the prison name no place; they follow the Jerusalem scenes
5:21 "they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught"; 5:25 "the men whom you put in prison are in the temple"
5:27 "they set them before the council" - the council scene names no place; it follows the Jerusalem scenes of 4:5-22
